name: Can an attached garage interior be converted into finished living space?

mainEntity.name: Can an attached garage interior be converted into finished living space?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, an attached garage can be converted into a fully finished room, though it requires addressing insulation, level flooring, and continuous air sealing. Attached garages built on concrete slabs sit below the main house subfloor and require framing adjustments, code-compliant insulation against exterior walls, and heating solutions. Working with HH Remodeling LLC provides a single point of contact for the framing, drywall, interior trim, and painting, while coordinated trade partners handle heating and electrical tie-ins to make the space match your home interior.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, attached garages can be converted into living spaces through proper insulation, wall framing, drywall, finish carpentry, and coordinated heating and electrical connections.
